name: taskseam
description: Continue versioned task state across AI agents with local evidence and per-agent deltas.

interface.longDescription: Load unseen task changes, preserve accepted decisions and open questions, and trace every item to local source evidence.
defaultPrompt: Continue this TaskSeam workspace from its latest unseen changes.
Show the current accepted decisions and unresolved questions.
Explain what changed in this task and cite its source evidence.
